## Unparented

### Phase 18: Reuse Balanced anchor entropy model

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase18-balanced-entropy-reuse/1`

Reduce repeated Balanced rate-probe work by training one fast entropy model on the first anchored plan and reusing that validated model for the second anchor, finalist, and correction. Keep Fast byte-identical and Quality exhaustive; retain the reuse only if exact writer sizing, target safety, decoder acceptance, deterministic output, and measured perceptual quality remain acceptable while the canonical speed gap materially narrows.
